panels.title: Recovery runs
panels.description: Recovery runs that match the filters and time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE disruption IS NOT NULL) THEN -1
       ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM runs
             WHERE disruption IS NOT NULL
               AND provider = ANY(string_to_array('${provider:csv}', ','))
               AND disruption = ANY(string_to_array('${disruption:csv}', ','))
               AND (CASE WHEN high_availability THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END) = ANY(string_to_array('${ha:csv}', ','))
               AND $__timeFilter(started_at))
       END AS runs

0.text: No recovery runs match the filters

panels.title: Provision time (minutes)
panels.description: Time from asking AWS to create the database until AWS reports it available. Grouped by provider, disruption, high availability and instance class.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT provider || '-' || disruption || CASE WHEN high_availability THEN '-ha' ELSE '' END || ' ' || coalesce(instance_class, '') AS setup,
       min(provision_seconds) / 60 AS min,
       avg(provision_seconds) / 60 AS average,
       max(provision_seconds) / 60 AS max
FROM runs
WHERE provider <> 'docker'
  AND provision_seconds IS NOT NULL
  AND provider IN ($provider) AND disruption IN ($disruption)
  AND (CASE WHEN high_availability THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END) IN ($ha)
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Writable downtime by provider and disruption (seconds)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.provider || ' ' || d.disruption || CASE WHEN r.high_availability THEN ' HA' ELSE '' END AS case_name,
       avg(d.writable_downtime_ms) / 1000 AS average,
       max(d.writable_downtime_ms) / 1000 AS max
FROM downtime_results d
JOIN runs r ON r.id = d.run_id
WHERE d.provider IN ($provider) AND d.disruption IN ($disruption)
  AND (CASE WHEN r.high_availability THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END) IN ($ha)
  AND $__timeFilter(d.disrupted_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', started_at) AS time,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE passed) AS completed,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE passed IS NOT TRUE) AS failed
FROM runs
WHERE disruption IS NOT NULL
  AND provider IN ($provider) AND disruption IN ($disruption)
  AND (CASE WHEN high_availability THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END) IN ($ha)
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Downtime per repetition

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.workflow_id, d.repetition, d.provider, d.disruption, r.instance_class, r.high_availability,
       d.writable_downtime_ms / 1000 AS writable_seconds,
       d.readable_downtime_ms / 1000 AS readable_seconds,
       d.lost_commits
FROM downtime_results d
JOIN runs r ON r.id = d.run_id
WHERE d.provider IN ($provider) AND d.disruption IN ($disruption)
  AND (CASE WHEN r.high_availability THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END) IN ($ha)
  AND d.repetition IN ($repetition)
  AND $__timeFilter(d.disrupted_at)
ORDER BY d.disrupted_at DESC

panels.description: One row per disruption: the detail behind the averages above. Filter by Repetition to compare the same disruption across runs.
